title: CtlDoctorResponse
description: The result of one `doctor` run — the fleet, one tenant, or one tenant against the preconditions of one operation (`?op=`). `hash` is sha256 over the canonical JSON of `findings` and is what a Plan pins (`doctor.hash`) and what `--force-with-doctor-diff HASH` must quote: an operator can only override the findings they have seen. `status` is the max over findings: no findings → `green`; only `warn` → `yellow`; any `error` → `red`, which blocks every mutation on that scope (409 `doctor_red`).

code.description: Stable snake_case identifier of the check, e.g. `worktree_gitdir_unreadable`, `es_heap_drift`, `vm_max_map_count_low`, `unit_path_group_writable`, `linger_disabled`, `env_grammar`, `manifest_mismatch`, `pid_owner_mismatch`, `disk_reserve`.

tenant.description: The tenant the finding is about; null for a host-level finding.

repair.description: The operation that would clear the finding, when one exists (e.g. `env-normalize`, `render-units`, `fleet enable-boot`) — a hint, never auto-run.
